verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a personalized dashboard that acts as a centralized hub for updates and documents. Received registered-agent mail is scanned and uploaded to a cloud storage account, and business licenses can be uploaded, viewed and shared through the account. Compliance-status notifications cover state filings. There is no evidence of managing multiple entities from one account or of team or multi-user access, which are core parts of this story. Missing for 10: documented multi-entity portfolio management in a single account, team/multi-user access and permissions, a consolidated view of state registrations across jurisdictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
